name: design
help: Prespecified laboratory design

name: alpha
help: Prespecified per-test significance level in (0,1)

name: power
help: Prespecified target power in (0,1)

name: ratio
help: Planned group2/group1 allocation ratio; paired and ANOVA require 1

name: dropout
help: Anticipated loss fraction in [0,1); zero is an explicit assumption

name: sided
help: Prespecified sidedness

name: direction
help: Signed effect orientation; not inferred from the supplied effect

name: groups
help: Complete ordered comma-separated group or paired-condition names

name: power-grid
help: Strictly increasing power values in (0,1), containing --power

name: biological-unit
help: Independent experimental unit; technical repeats never count as n

name: unit-description
help: Explain independence, allocation and biological replication

name: technical-replicates
help: Number of planned technical measurements per biological unit and condition

name: technical-policy
help: Required exclusion of technical repeats from biological n

name: planning-stage
help: Only a priori planning; no completed-study observed power

name: effect-source
help: Provenance of the independently chosen planning effect

name: effect-rationale
help: Concrete source, assumptions and rationale; no inferred recommendation

name: outcome-unit
help: Raw outcome unit or explicitly dimensionless scale

name: mean1
help: Group1 planning mean

name: mean2
help: Group2 planning mean

name: sd
help: Positive common SD
when: design=mean_2sample and neither sd1 nor sd2 is supplied

name: sd1
help: Positive group1 or condition1 SD; pooled Student planning, not Welch

name: sd2
help: Positive group2 or condition2 SD; pooled Student planning, not Welch

name: mean-diff
help: Signed group1-minus-group2 paired difference

name: sd-diff
help: Positive SD of paired differences
when: design=mean_paired and the sd1/sd2/corr triple is absent

name: corr
help: Paired correlation strictly between -1 and 1

name: k
help: Number of equal-sized ANOVA groups, integer at least 2

name: f
help: Positive omnibus Cohen f; cannot be combined with means/sd

name: means
help: Comma-separated ANOVA planning means in complete group order

name: p1
help: Group1 planning probability strictly between 0 and 1

name: p2
help: Group2 planning probability strictly between 0 and 1

name: hr
help: Positive group1/group2 hazard ratio, different from 1

name: event-prob
help: Optional pooled event probability in (0,1]; absent means events only, biological N unknown

name: journal
help: OmicStat presentation preset; does not change planning values

name: study-contract
help: Validated a priori StudyContract; no participant-level input

name: development-mode
help: Explicit execution of an unaccepted candidate

name: seed
help: Recorded reproducibility seed; no stochastic estimator is substituted

name: outdir
help: New or empty output directory

name: spec
help: Resolved-spec replay; all scientific assumptions remain explicit
